checklist.title: Set up the AI Dungeon Master
checklist.intro: These steps take a campaign from no AI to a working AI DM. Each step below reads its real state and links straight to the control that changes it.
checklist.allDoneDriver: The AI holds the DM seat and acts directly — it narrates, rolls dice, applies HP and conditions, and runs the session within the budget you set. Players join the live session from Encounters.
checklist.allDoneCoDm: The AI is co-DMing — it only proposes, and nothing lands in canon until a human DM approves it.
checklist.unavailable: Readiness could not be loaded. Try again from campaign settings.

dashboard.hintBody: This campaign can run an AI co-DM (it only proposes — you approve every change) or a Driver session (the AI acts directly as the DM). A few settings turn it on.

badge.coDmAria: An AI is co-DMing this campaign — it only proposes; a human DM approves. What that means
badge.driverAria: An AI is running this campaign directly as the DM — open Encounters

transparency.title: What the AI sees and does
transparency.body: The AI DM is given this campaign's summary and its session-zero charter — never any other campaign's data. If you configure an external AI provider, that context is sent to the endpoint you chose; see the AI privacy notice in provider settings for the full list and retention terms. The two modes have different authority. Co-DM asks: it only drafts proposals, and a human DM must approve every one before anything changes — the AI never writes to canon directly. Driver acts: the AI holds the DM seat and runs the session itself — narrating, rolling dice, applying HP and conditions, and resolving live play within the budget you set. Canon edits (new NPCs, quests, locations) still become proposals for DM review. In Driver mode the DM and the table can pause the AI or take the seat back at any time from the running encounter.

mcp.label: وكيل MCP خارجي
mcp.body: يمكن لوكيل متصل بشكل منفصل استخدام أدوات Campfire للتحضير أو اللعب، لكنه لا يشغّل دردشة Driver المدمجة هذه.

flagDisabled.title: Server AI is turned off
flagDisabled.body: AI features are experimental and disabled server-wide. A server admin must enable them before the AI DM can run.

seatDisabled.title: The AI DM isn't switched on
seatDisabled.body: This campaign's AI DM seat is off. Choose a mode in campaign settings: Co-DM (the AI only proposes — a human DM approves every change) or Driver (the AI acts directly as the DM).

budgetExhausted.title: Token budget used up
budgetExhausted.body: The AI DM has spent its token budget. Raise the budget (or reset usage) to continue.

serverCap.title: Server AI budget reached
serverCap.body: The server-wide AI token cap has been reached. A server admin must raise it in the AI console.

needBudget.title: Driver mode needs a budget
needBudget.body: Driver mode requires a positive token budget. Set one, then switch the mode to Driver.

needProvider.title: Driver mode needs a provider
needProvider.body: Driver mode requires a configured AI provider with an API key. Set one, then switch the mode to Driver.

needModel.title: Driver mode needs an executable model
needModel.body: The selected AI model must pass the server allowlist and provider policy before Driver can run.

needDriverTools.title: Driver mode needs tool calls
needDriverTools.body: Driver mode requires a provider that supports tool/function calls so it can use Campfire tools safely.

paused.title: The AI DM is paused
paused.body: The session is paused. The DM can resume it from the running encounter.

humanControl.title: A human holds the seat
humanControl.body: A human has taken over the DM seat. The AI won't act until control is handed back.

cost.cannotEstimate: Campfire cannot estimate cost — monitor your provider’s billing.

unknown.noPricingConfigured: No model pricing has been set up on this server. A server admin can add it in the AI console.
unknown.modelNotPriced: No price is on file for this provider and model. A server admin can add one in the AI console.
unknown.customEndpointNotPriced: This campaign uses a custom endpoint, and a model name behind a proxy or self-hosted server does not imply the vendor’s price. A server admin can add a price for this endpoint in the AI console.
unknown.noProvider: No provider and model are configured yet, so there is nothing to price.
unknown.providerUnresolved: This campaign’s AI provider is configured but could not be resolved, so there is nothing to price. See the Executable model check above for the reason — a stored key that can no longer be decrypted after the server’s AI_CONFIG_KEY changed is the usual cause.
unknown.generic: No price is on file for this configuration.

cost.scopeBudget: to spend this whole budget, estimated

cost.referenceAsOf: These figures were prefilled from Campfire’s reference list as of {{date}}. Prices change without notice — re-check them against your provider.
cost.scopeCaveat: This campaign’s AI seat only — not your server’s total AI spend, and not any other campaign.
